Due to legal restrictions on the handling and storage of these high-power lithium batteries, any returns require the red transportation cap to be accepted in any of our stores.

DEWALT DCB547-XJ 54V 9.0Ah Li-Ion XR FlexVolt battery delivers robust power for cordless tools. Voltage steps up to 54V, providing high performance for demanding applications such as heavy-duty cutting or drilling on construction sites. Built-in LED fuel gauge offers instant charge status, allowing tradespeople to manage workflow efficiently. The high-capacity battery ensures extended run time, reducing interruptions during long working days. Compatible with all XR FlexVolt, 18V XR and 54V XR tools and 18V XR chargers.
b: Versatile Power Source for Multiple Tools
